name: forma-organizer
description: Business document understanding, structured organization preview, approval-bound apply, and optional DEVONthink archival expert for WorkBuddy.

profession.zh: 业务文档理解与归档专家

displayDescription.en: WorkBuddy-native business document organizer: understands content and project relationships, previews a structured plan, applies safely on approval, and optionally indexes to DEVONthink.
displayDescription.zh: 面向业务文档理解与结构化归档的WorkBuddy专家，支持内容推理、方案预览、批准执行与安全恢复。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请整理我选定的文件夹：先只读检查并展示整理方案预览，经我确认后再执行。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Organize my selected folder: inspect read-only and show a preview plan first, then apply only after my approval.

quickPrompts.zh: 请整理我选定的文件夹：先只读检查并展示整理方案预览，经我确认后再执行。
quickPrompts.en: Organize my selected folder: inspect read-only and show a preview plan first, then apply only after my approval.

quickPrompts.zh: 仅检查选定文件夹并生成整理方案预览，不要修改或移动任何文件。
quickPrompts.en: Inspect the selected folder and propose an organization plan without modifying or moving any files.

quickPrompts.zh: 请帮我审阅或恢复上一次的文档整理方案与执行日志。
quickPrompts.en: Review or recover my previous document organization plan and execution journal.
